hero.title: What stopped you?
paragraphs: Tell us what you were trying to do, what happened and the result you need. Name the project or payment when it matters to the question.

items.title: Topic
items.text: Choose the part of AI Chat your question concerns.

items.title: What happened?
items.text: Describe the action, the result and any message you saw.

items.title: What result do you need?
items.text: Explain what you want to continue or correct.

items.title: Project documents
items.text: Drafts, identified shortcomings, edits and review.

items.title: Files and images
items.text: Adding material or working with supplied files.

items.title: Tokens and payment
items.text: Balance, top-ups, receipts or a payment result.

response.title: What happens next
paragraphs: Support requests are processed within 24 hours. This is the initial response expectation, not a promise to resolve every request within that time. Continuous live support is outside the current service.
Keep your saved documents and task in place while you wait. [Return to the workspace](/ai-chat/projects/example).

success.title: Request submitted
paragraphs: We’ll respond within 24 hours. You can keep working in your workspace while you wait.
